prompt: protobuf allow_alias enum all values distinct numbers behavior
answer:
If `option allow_alias = true` is set but all enum values have distinct numbers, the Protobuf compiler reports an error:

> “declares support for enum aliases but no enum values share field numbers. Please remove the unnecessary `option allow_alias = true;` declaration.”

So `allow_alias` must be removed unless at least two enum names share the same numeric value.
